title: Google’s new ‘CC’ is an AI agent that helps families run their households
slides: Can an AI agent really run your household?
Google's 'CC' schedules chores, meals, and reminders.
It learns your family's routines—then suggests changes you didn't expect.
You'll receive daily nudges to keep everyone on track.
Try letting it plan one week, then judge.
thread_text:
1. Your House, Run by AI

Google's 'CC' already schedules chores, meals, and reminders for your family. It learns your routines—then suggests changes you didn't expect.

2. What Can It Actually Do?

Daily nudges keep everyone on track, but the real surprise is how it adapts when your schedule shifts. You might not even notice it's working.

3. The Unexpected Suggestions

After a week, it'll propose tweaks to your routines—like shifting dinner time or swapping chores. Some ideas will feel intrusive, others genius.

4. Why Trust It?

The system watches patterns you didn't know you had. That means it can spot inefficiencies, but also might push changes you never asked for.

5. Try One Week, Then Judge

Let it plan your household for seven days. If you haven't tested it, start with a single routine. Does it save time—or just add another layer to manage?

instagram.caption:
Google's new AI agent will schedule your family's chores and meals, then suggest changes you didn't ask for. 🍽️

It's called CC, and it learns your household routines over time.

Every day it sends nudges to keep everyone on track.

After a week, it starts proposing tweaks—like shifting dinner time or swapping who does what. Some will feel intrusive, others useful.

If you manage family logistics, this could quietly rewrite your weekly planning.

Would you hand it one routine for seven days and see what it changes? 🤖
